subject: Credit backstop for OpenStitch community sprint — request & approval
messages:
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@openstitch.org>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: devteam@openstitch.org
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Request: credits for OpenStitch Community Sprint (Oct/Nov)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team found the latency profile and caching demo super compelling. We're running a community sprint + mentor program across two weekends (Oct 23–25 and Nov 6–8) and would like to request a short-term credit backstop to cover burst usage for workshop demos and CI test runs.

Quick details:
- Expected active participants: ~180 contributors across workshops
- Peak concurrent inference for demos: ~12 sessions (short prompts, chat-style)
- Estimated token usage: rough guess 80k–150k tokens per weekend
- Use case: demo environments, mentor sandbox accounts, and a small eval harness for regression tests

Attached is our sprint proposal (openstitch-sprint-proposal.pdf) and a basic budget. Would you be able to provide trial credits or a short extension to keep the demo environments stable? We can share org billing contact and sign an SOW if needed.

Appreciate any help — micah@devfest.org is co-organizing and copied for logistics.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Nguyen
Community Lead, OpenStitch Foundation
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@openstitch.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: credits for OpenStitch Community Sprint (Oct/Nov)

Alyssa — thanks for the note and the proposal. Happy to help get you set up. A few quick questions so we can scope the appropriate backstop:

- Can you confirm exact start/end datetimes for the two weekends (timezone)?
- Do you want one pooled org credit bucket or per-mentor/test account limits?
- Any expectation for production-quality SLAs or is this purely demo/test traffic?
- Billing contact & legal (for SOW/DocuSign) — name and email

If you can get those to me today/tomorrow we can put a recommended credit amount on the table. Marissa — looping you in for typical community program sizing. Karthik — will need a quick check on how we split credits if we approve.

Short next steps I propose:
1) Alyssa confirms details above
2) Redwood recommends credit amount and term
3) Finance approves and legal signs a short SOW (if required)

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Partner & Community Outreach
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: credits for OpenStitch Community Sprint (Oct/Nov)

+1 to supporting OpenStitch here — they've run a few healthy contributor events and the community lift tends to bring new devs to our model catalog. My recommendation:

- Approve a one-time credit pool of 120,000 tokens (usable across both weekends)
- Reserve 10 mentor sandbox seats with per-seat caps of 6,000 tokens each to prevent runaway CI usage
- Offer a 30-day follow-up slot with our developer advocates for onboarding/feedback

I've attached a quick budget breakdown that maps to those numbers (budget-breakdown.xlsx). If finance is comfortable, we can ship without a full SOW but will require a brief DocuSign confirmation of the credit terms.

Marissa
Director, Developer Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: credits for OpenStitch Community Sprint (Oct/Nov)

Thanks — finance ok with the 120,000 token pool with one adjustment: split the pool into 80k for demos/eval and 40k reserved for mentor sandboxes (with the per-seat caps Marissa suggested). We want clear tracking so please make sure the org uses two separate billing allocations.

I'm attaching a snapshot of the approval note (signature-snapshot.png) and will kick off the DocuSign SOW (link below) — legal wants the SOW for audit trail even though this is low-risk. Approving now so we can meet their schedule.

DocuSign SOW: https://docusign.example.com/OPST-4932/sow

Karthik
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@openstitch.org>, Micah Barnes <micah@devfest.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: credits for OpenStitch Community Sprint (Oct/Nov)

Alyssa / Micah — great news: we have internal approval to provide a short-term credit backstop. Summary of what's approved:

- Total credit: 120,000 tokens across both weekends
  - 80,000 tokens allocated to demo/eval workloads (pooled)
  - 40,000 tokens reserved for up to 10 mentor sandbox seats (caps of 6,000 tokens each)
- Term: valid from Oct 21, 2026 until Nov 30, 2026 (gives you cushion for follow-up testing)
- Requirement: sign brief DocuSign confirmation of credit terms (link below)

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/OPST-4932/sow
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/OPST-4932

Next steps for you:
1) Sign the DocuSign SOW so we can provision the billing allocations (legal needs this for audit).
2) Send the list of mentor sandbox accounts (emails) so we can apply per-seat caps.
3) If you want the developer advocates slot, tell us 2 preferred dates in Nov.

I'll provision the credit pool as soon as the SOW is signed. Congrats — excited to see what the community builds.

Best,
Soojin
Head of Partner & Community Outreach
Redwood Inference
